blocks.text: It gives me great satisfaction to welcome you to the official website of the Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan.

Human rights are not a privilege reserved for a particular class, community, or individual. They are the fundamental rights of every human being. The dignity of a person, access to justice, equality before the law, freedom from oppression, and the right to live with security and respect are the foundations of a just and peaceful society.

The Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan was established with a clear purpose: to stand with the oppressed, raise a voice for those who cannot be heard, and work for the supremacy of human rights, institutional transparency, accountability, and justice.

Our work is rooted in the belief that meaningful human rights protection requires more than words. It requires responsible action, lawful advocacy, transparency, documentation, public awareness, and constructive engagement with institutions. We believe that strong institutions and protected citizens are not competing interests. Rather, transparent, accountable, and lawful institutions are essential to protecting the rights and dignity of citizens.

Through our efforts, we seek to address matters affecting vulnerable and disadvantaged communities, promote the right to information, support access to essential public services, highlight environmental and social concerns, assist innocent and deserving persons facing injustice, and encourage greater trust between citizens and public institutions.

As Chairman, I consider it both a responsibility and a privilege to serve this cause. My experience as a journalist, author, social worker, and human rights activist has strengthened my conviction that silence in the face of injustice can never be a substitute for courage, conscience, and lawful action.

The journey of human rights is not easy. It demands patience, integrity, courage, and an unwavering commitment to truth. We may not be able to solve every problem, but we can refuse to ignore injustice. We can listen to those who are unheard. We can document what others overlook. We can ask difficult questions through lawful and constitutional means. Most importantly, we can continue to believe that every human being deserves dignity and justice.

I invite citizens, civil society organizations, professionals, institutions, philanthropists, and people of conscience to join hands with the Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan in building a society where human dignity is respected, justice is accessible, institutions are transparent, and no vulnerable person is left without hope.
Our commitment is simple:
To protect human dignity.
To speak for the voiceless.
To promote transparency and accountability.
To uphold the rule of law.
And to remain a ray of hope for the oppressed.
May our collective efforts contribute to a more just, transparent, peaceful, and humane Pakistan.
Muhammad Yousaf Badar
Chairman
Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan

blocks.text: Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan (HRPF) is a non-governmental, non-political and public-interest organization committed to the promotion, protection and advancement of human rights in Pakistan. The Foundation stands as a voice of hope for oppressed, vulnerable and marginalized communities and works for a society where human dignity, equality, justice, transparency and the rule of law are respected and protected.

Founded on the principles of human dignity, justice, accountability, transparency and public service, Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan seeks to bridge the gap between citizens and institutions by raising legitimate public concerns and advocating for lawful, fair and transparent institutional practices.

Our work focuses on identifying human rights violations, supporting vulnerable individuals and communities, promoting access to information, encouraging institutional accountability, and strengthening public awareness about fundamental rights and legal protections.

blocks.text: Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan works in areas including:

items: Protection and promotion of human rights
Support for vulnerable and marginalized communities
Access to information and transparency
Institutional accountability and public-interest advocacy
Legal and humanitarian support for deserving cases
Assistance in cases involving innocent and vulnerable prisoners
Environmental protection and public health awareness
Access to clean drinking water and essential services
Maternal and community welfare initiatives
Rehabilitation and support for affected communities
Awareness regarding human trafficking and human smuggling
Strengthening trust between citizens and public institutions

reviewTasks: Review sourced English copy before publication.

blocks.text: Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan works through research, public awareness, documentation, complaints, representations, requests for information, institutional engagement and lawful advocacy. We seek solutions through constitutional, legal and peaceful means while encouraging public institutions to fulfil their responsibilities effectively and transparently.

We also believe that strong public institutions and strong human rights are not opposing objectives. Transparent, accountable and responsive institutions are essential for the protection of citizens' rights and the development of a just society.

reviewTasks: Review sourced English copy before publication.

blocks.text: Our commitment is to stand with those whose voices are weak, unheard or overlooked. We strive to bring genuine public-interest issues to the attention of the relevant authorities and to encourage meaningful action within the framework of law.
Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan is a ray of hope for the oppressed, working for human dignity, justice, transparency and a more accountable society.
Our vision is simple: Human Rights for All, Justice with Dignity, and Institutions with Transparency and Accountability.

reviewTasks: Review sourced English copy before publication.

blocks.text: The mission of the Human Rights Protection Foundation (HRPF) is to uphold and champion human dignity and rights by advocating for transparency, environmental sustainability, and equal access to essential resources and services. We firmly believe that an informed society is an empowered society. Therefore, we actively promote the Right to Information Act, ensuring that communities have access to vital knowledge that enables them to make informed decisions and demand accountability from institutions.

We work diligently to combat pollution and environmental degradation, striving for a cleaner and healthier planet where future generations can flourish. Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental human right, and we are committed to ensuring that underprivileged communities have safe and reliable water sources. Additionally, we focus on improving maternal healthcare services, particularly in marginalized areas, to safeguard the well-being of mothers and infants.

One of our core missions is to advocate for the release of innocent individuals who have been unjustly imprisoned. We provide legal aid, raise awareness, and mobilize support to prevent wrongful convictions and ensure fair trials. Furthermore, we actively uphold human rights by offering advocacy and support to those facing injustices, discrimination, or exploitation.

In times of crisis, we lead reconstruction and rehabilitation efforts in affected communities, helping them rebuild their lives with dignity and stability. By addressing both immediate needs and long-term solutions, we aim to create a just, equitable, and thriving society where every individual can live freely, safely, and with the full realization of their rights.
At HRPF, we remain steadfast in our commitment to human rights, justice, and social equity, working towards a world where every person can live with dignity, freedom, and equal
opportunities.

reviewTasks: Review sourced English copy before publication.

blocks.text: At the Human Rights Protection Foundation (HRPF), we envision a world where every individual enjoys their full human rights, regardless of nationality, race, gender, or socioeconomic background. We aspire to create a society where people live in a clean and sustainable environment, free from pollution and environmental hazards, ensuring a healthy and dignified life for all.

We believe that access to essential services, such as healthcare, education, clean water, and justice, is a fundamental right of every human being. Our goal is to empower communities, enabling them to thrive independently and contribute positively to society. We are committed to fostering a world that is free from unjust imprisonment, discrimination, and human rights violations.

Our vision is deeply rooted in the principles of dignity, freedom, and global solidarity. We strive to build a future where justice prevails, equity is upheld, and prosperity is shared among all people, ensuring a world where human rights are universally respected and protected.

reviewTasks: Review sourced English copy before publication.

items: Integrity — We act with honesty, transparency, and professional ethics in all our endeavours.
Justice — We believe in equal access to justice and the rule of law for every citizen.
Accountability — We hold institutions accountable and we hold ourselves to the same standard.
Inclusivity — We work for all communities regardless of gender, religion, or social status.
Independence — We operate free from partisan political influence or vested interests.
Sustainability — We integrate environmental stewardship into our human rights framework.

payload.title: Aims & Objectives

items: To advocate for the supremacy of human rights, with particular emphasis on women's rights, children's rights, educational rights, prisoners' rights, and the rights of vulnerable populations.
To promote institutional transparency and accountability in accordance with the Right to Information (RTI) Act and applicable laws of Pakistan.
To undertake activities in health, education, poverty alleviation, environmental protection, family planning, reproductive health, and mother-and-child healthcare.
To document, report, and intervene in cases of human rights violations, police misconduct, and abuse of authority.
To support freedom of the press and freedom of expression worldwide, and to protect threatened journalists.
To develop national policy, civil society capacity, and human resources through education, research, and training.
To promote scientific research, vocational training, and income generation in rural and underserved communities.
To cooperate with government authorities, international bodies, and civil society organizations in advancing HRPF's humanitarian mandate.
To provide shelter, rehabilitation, and humanitarian assistance to flood victims, disaster-affected communities, orphans, refugees, and persons deprived of liberty.
To promote interfaith harmony, cultural preservation, and community cohesion across Pakistan.
To undertake and execute any other lawful activity incidental or conducive to the attainment of the foregoing objects.

blocks.text: Human Rights Advocacy
Documentation, reporting, and legal intervention in cases of human rights violations — including custodial abuse, police misconduct, and denial of due process.
Women's Rights & Gender Equality
Combating domestic violence, gender discrimination, and ensuring women's access to justice, education, and economic opportunity.
Children's Rights
Advocacy against child labour, child sexual abuse, and denial of educational rights; support for children in jails and conflict-affected zones.
Right to Information (RTI)
Institutional advocacy for transparency and access to public information under the RTI Act 2017; filing of formal RTI appeals before the Pakistan Information Commission.
Freedom of the Press
Protection of journalists from threats and violence; combating yellow journalism; advocacy for media freedom at national and district levels.
Environmental Justice & Climate Change
Raising awareness on floods, earthquakes, and climate-related crises; advocating for environmental policy reform and community resilience.
Prisoners' Rights
Monitoring detention conditions in district jails; facilitating access to legal aid for innocent prisoners and under-trial detainees.
Disaster Relief & Humanitarian Aid
Emergency response to floods, droughts, and other natural disasters; provision of relief goods and rehabilitation support to affected communities.
Civic Accountability
Filing of formal complaints to Ombudsman offices, NEPRA, NCHR, and other regulatory bodies on behalf of citizens aggrieved by institutional failures.
Interfaith Harmony & Social Cohesion
Promotion of tolerance, coexistence, and community dialogue across religious and ethnic boundaries.
Education & Literacy
Support for educational institutions; collaboration with Punjab Education Foundation; youth awareness campaigns.
Anti-Human Trafficking
Awareness campaigns and reporting mechanisms to combat human trafficking and modern slavery.
